englishText: O my Lord! The calamity has aggravated; the absence prolonged;
The curtain of modesty has been lifted; hope has been curtailed;
The earth has been narrow; and sky has been denied.
And You are the One from whom help is sought and complaints are made

arabicText: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَالرَّخَاءِ،
englishText: And in You we trust in the times of difficulty.

arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
englishText: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad (S) and the progeny of Muhammad (S),

arabicText: أُوْلِي الْأَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَا عَتَهُمْ
englishText: The possessors of authority whose obedience you have enjoined upon us

arabicText: وَ عَرَّفْتَنَا بِذَالِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ ، فَفَّرِجْ عَنَّا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجاً عَاجِلاً قَرِيْباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ
englishText: And by that made us aware of their position. Then make open for us, by their truth, an immediate opening, immediate as a wink or sooner.
O Muhammad! O ‘Ali! O ‘Ali! O Muhammad!

arabicText: ِكْفِيَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا كَافِيَانِ وَ انْصُرَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا نَاصِرَانِ
englishText: Suffice me both of you as both of you are sufficient.Help me—two of you—for you are my helpers.
O our Master, O Master of the Time!
Rescue me! Rescue me! Rescue me!
This moment! This moment! This moment!

arabicText: ثم يمكنك أن تصفع فخذك الأيمن بيدك ثلاث مرات، وفي كل مرة تقول الكلمات التالية:
englishText: You may then slap your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following words:

arabicText: يَا أَرْحَمَ لرَّاحِمِيْنَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ الطَّا هِرِيْنَ
englishText: O Most Merciful of the Merciful,For the sake of Muhammad (S) and his holy progeny.
